## Details
### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-001** — IMU App Execution Rate

- **Description:** The IMU app shall execute at 200 Hz on the static schedule.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-005 200 Hz IMU sample rate; the app drives per-cycle library reads.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-005
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-002** — IMU Sample Read Per Cycle

- **Description:** The IMU app shall read one IMU sample from the IMU library on each scheduled cycle.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-001 raw sensor logging path; one sample per 200 Hz tick supports full-rate logging.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-001
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-003** — IMU Message Publication

- **Description:** The IMU app shall publish each IMU sample as a structured message on the software bus.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-001; downstream nav, logging, and telemetry apps consume IMU samples via the bus.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-001
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-004** — Monotonic Timestamp on IMU Message

- **Description:** The IMU app shall stamp each published IMU message with monotonic microseconds since startup.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-026 single monotonic time base and SYS-027 per-sample timestamping.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-026
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-005** — Pass-Through Sample Content

- **Description:** The IMU app shall publish IMU samples without filtering, integration, or other transformation.
- **Rationale:** PM-defined view-layer scope; the IMU app is pass-through with no business logic.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-001
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-006** — Body-Frame Axis Convention in Message

- **Description:** The IMU app shall report accelerometer and gyroscope vectors in the X-forward, Y-right, Z-down frame.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-057 body axes convention so consumers receive samples in the documented frame.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-057
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-007** — IMU Health Publication

- **Description:** The IMU app shall publish IMU health status on the software bus on each scheduled cycle.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-031 continuous sensor health bitmap; sys_app aggregates per-sensor health from the bus.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-008** — Deterministic IMU App Behavior

- **Description:** The IMU app shall produce identical published messages given identical library sample inputs.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-044 determinism; supports repeatable Trick simulation.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-009** — Accelerometer Range Verification

- **Description:** The IMU app shall verify the accelerometer range is configured to plus or minus 16 G.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-006; the app verifies the library configuration matches the FT1 flight envelope.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-006
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-IMU-APP-010** — Gyroscope Range Verification

- **Description:** The IMU app shall verify the gyroscope range is configured to plus or minus 2000 dps.
- **Rationale:** Derived from SYS-007; the app verifies the library configuration matches the FT1 rotation envelope.
